title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace / account & security
walkthrough:
You arrive at a single card headed by the product name "ANDS Studio" with a small dot beside it. The heading reads "Sign in", and beneath it a line of small text: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." There are two fields: "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password". The main button "Sign in →" is disabled until both fields have something in them; while a request runs it reads "Working…". Next to it a secondary button reads "New client? Create a workspace", and below, a smaller "Forgot password?" button.

Clicking "New client? Create a workspace" changes the heading to "Create your workspace" with the line "One workspace per client company — dossiers, documents and filings stay isolated." A third field appears above Email: "Company / client name" (placeholder "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). Under the password field, live text tracks what you type: before typing it shows "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers."; once valid it shows "✓ Meets the password rules."; otherwise "✗ At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers." plus, when short, a remaining count like "(4 more characters)". The main button reads "Create workspace →", and the secondary swaps to "Have an account? Sign in".

Clicking "Forgot password?" shows "Reset your password" with the text "Enter your account email. We issue a one-time code (expires in 15 minutes) to set a new password." One button, "Send me a code →", enabled once Email is filled, plus "Back to sign in". After the code is issued, a server message appears, and in this deployment a highlighted notice reads: "Demo environment — no outbound email. Your one-time code is shown on-screen below. In a production deployment this code is emailed to [your address] and never displayed." followed by "One-time code:" and the code itself. Two fields follow: "One-time code" (placeholder "8-digit code") and "New password" with the same live rule check. "Set new password →" stays disabled until both are filled. On success you are returned to the sign-in view with the notice "Password updated — sign in with your new password."

If you sign in to an account with multi-factor authentication enabled, a new field appears on the card: "Authenticator code" (placeholder "6-digit code", focused automatically), with the note "This account has multi-factor authentication enabled — enter the current code from your authenticator app." If the code you enter fails, the error reads "That code didn't verify — codes rotate every 30 seconds; try the current one." Other failures show rewritten messages — a wrong password shows "That email and password didn't match — try again, or use "Forgot password?"."; an expired session shows "Your session has ended — please sign in again."

Once signed in, the header shows a user chip: your email in bold followed by " · " and your workspace name in smaller muted text. The workspace name comes from the server account record (an older browser-stored value is only a fallback). The chip links to the Account page; its tooltip reads "Account & security (workspace, MFA)". Beside it is a "Sign out" button that ends the session and returns you to the sign-in page.

The Account page header reads "ANDS Studio · account & security" with navigation chips: "Dossier manager", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", and "Guided journey →". Under the page title "Account & security" are four panels.

"Who you are here" shows "Loading your account…" and then three lines: "Signed in as" with your email, "Workspace" with the name (or "—") and the note "(from the account record — every dossier, document and filing here is isolated to this workspace)", and "Role" with your role.

"Multi-factor authentication" first shows "Checking MFA status…". If not set up, it reads: "Add a time-based one-time code (TOTP) from any standard authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy…) as a second factor. Recommended for every account that can sign or transmit." with a button "Set up authenticator app →". Clicking it shows "Step 1 — add this secret to your authenticator app (or paste the setup link into an app that accepts otpauth URIs):" with the secret displayed and a "Copy setup link" button that briefly changes to "Copied ✓". "Step 2 — enter the current 6-digit code to confirm:" has an input (placeholder "6-digit code") and a "Turn on MFA →" button ("Verifying…" while checking), disabled until a code is entered, with the note "Nothing is enforced until this code verifies — if you stop here, sign-in stays password-only." Once verified, the panel shows a chip "Enabled ✓" and: "Sign-ins to this account now require a 6-digit code from your authenticator app in addition to your password."

"Password & sessions" lists three points: passwords must be at least 10 characters with letters and numbers and are stored only as salted hashes; to change your password you sign out and use "Forgot password?" — a one-time code (15-minute expiry) sets the new one and signs out every other session on the account; sessions last 12 hours and live in an HttpOnly cookie so page scripts can never read your token.

"Deployment & data residency" states: ANDS Studio is self-hosted — every service and database runs inside your own environment, and nothing leaves it except the packages you deliberately transmit to Health Canada; every record is scoped to this workspace at every service, with cross-workspace reads refused at the API, not just hidden in the UI; and "Honest limits: single sign-on (SAML/OIDC) is not yet available — accounts are per-workspace, with TOTP MFA above as the second factor. Every state change lands on the append-only audit event stream."
